title: View today's sales
text: Use this to check the sales for today. The dashboard shows the total for the selected day, while Daily Sales lists each day and Sales History shows each receipt.
steps: Click Dashboard in the sidebar. Set the date range to today.
For a day-by-day list, click Sidebar > Reporting, then Daily Sales. Pick the dates and click Generate Report.
To see each receipt, click Point of Sale, then More Options, then View Sales History.
For one shift, print an X reading from Cashier Report on the register.

title: Run a report
text: Pick a report, set the filters, and generate it. The results open on screen so you can review, export, or print them.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting.
Find the report you want in the list or by search.
Set the date range and any other filter that applies.
Click Generate Report. The results load on the page.

title: Export or print a report
text: After a report loads, you can export it to Excel or PDF, or print it directly. The file name usually includes the date range.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting. Pick the report and click Generate Report.
Use the buttons above the table to export as Excel, PDF, or print it.
On a phone, these actions are grouped in one Export or print menu.
The E-Journal is different. It downloads as a text file using Download TXT.

title: Choose the date range
text: Use the date range to focus the report on the period you want. The default is usually today, but you can choose a preset or a custom range.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting. Pick a report.
Click the period button in the filter bar.
Pick a preset, or choose a start date and end date on the calendar.
Some reports also let you set a From and To time.
Click Clear to go back to today. Reports like Low Stock Warning and Batch & Expiry do not use dates.

title: Filter a report by product, cashier, customer, or terminal
text: Most reports let you narrow the results by product, cashier, customer, supplier, or terminal. Leave a filter blank to include everything.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting. Pick the report.
Look at the filter bar or the right panel, depending on your layout.
Pick a product, category, user, customer, supplier, or terminal.
Use Cash In / Cash Out to show only entries or only outflows.
Click Generate Report again after changing a filter.

title: Favorite reports
text: Star a report to keep it at the top of the list for quick access. Favorites are saved per branch.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting.
Point to a report in the list and click the star.
Click the star again to remove it from Favorites.
Click Clear in the Favorites header to remove them all.

title: Reports for all branches
text: Use All Branch to view a report across every branch in the business. Not every report supports this, but many sales and summary reports do.
steps: Click the branch name at the top of the page and choose All Branch. Owners only.
Click Reporting in the sidebar. Only the reports that work across branches are listed.
Run and export the report as usual.
Switch back to one branch to see the full list again.

title: BIR reports and the E-Journal
text: BIR reports appear only when the branch is marked BIR Registered. They include the E-1 reports, the E-Journal, and related summary and refund files.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Business Details. Check that BIR Registered is on.
Click Sidebar > Reporting. Scroll to BIR Reports at the bottom of the list.
Open the report you need. Some previews are scrollable tables, while exports are still PDF or Excel.
The E-Journal downloads as a text file. Click Download TXT.

title: Z reading report
text: The Z reading report shows the end-of-day readings your terminals saved. The actual reading is made at the register, and this page is where you view or print it later.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting.
Under Cash Management, click Z Reading.
Pick the date and click Generate Report. Each reading shows as a receipt.
Click Export Excel, Export PDF, or Print above it.
To run it automatically, click Sidebar > Settings, then General, and turn on Auto Z-Reading.
